dct_description_sm: This study was conducted to assess under-ice sedimentation during the entire period of ice algal production on the Mackenzie shelf. The export of sea-ice particulate material is a key component of pelagic and benthic carbon cycling on Arctic shelves. Data is provided on depth-related changes in under-ice sinking fluxes (amount and composition) in order to better understand carbon cycling under variable sea-ice conditions.
dct_title_s: Sinking export of particulate material under first-year sea ice during the winter-spring transition on the Mackenzie shelf
